scope.goal: Render the missing encounter-grass composition, restore dirt/lawn paint, and remove opaque ordinary-vegetation carrier rectangles before further lighting work.

composition_manifest.expansion: exact collision core plus the accepted unique eight-neighbor ring shifted halfway toward the nearest core cell

material.current_boundary: The completeness pass preserves source geometry, Texture01, UV0, Color0, and cutout. Recovered joint-matrix wind and the remaining FieldEncGrass lighting terms are a later parity pass.

ground_role_reconciliation.root_cause: The two authored mask roles were interpreted in reverse. greenblend01_com is opaque low-frequency texture-variation noise, so reading its alpha as the route paint forced every ground fragment to lawn.
corrected_contract: GrassBlendTex / greenblend01_com red mixes each soil and grass texture pair on UV0 multiplied by 0.3.
BlendTex / glassmask01_com samples on authored UV2.
BlendTex alpha selects soil or lawn.
BlendTex RGB multiplies the authored surface and edge decoration.

texture_evidence.observation: BC1 variation texture with opaque alpha
authored UV2 dirt/lawn and edge-decoration atlas

ordinary_vegetation_role_reconciliation.root_cause: The grass base and decoration atlas roles were reversed. Sampling the opaque grass01_com base on UV1 made every decoration carrier visible as a rectangular lawn card.
corrected_contract: TextureMap01 and TextureMap02 are the UV0 base-grass pair.
green_blend red mixes the base pair on UV0 multiplied by 0.3.
green_hikari is the UV1 RGBA decoration atlas.
green_hikari alpha is tested against the source 0.85 cutoff.
The accepted continuous raised-lawn Color0 tint is used for horizontal grass01_com_001 floor carriers.

runtime: Vulkan direct, indirect, and both dual-source fragment variants compile.
D3D12 startup creates the world pipeline successfully.
Sequential identical canonical-scene preparation is regression-tested against stale render-object handles.

open_boundaries: FieldEncGrassShader01 recovered wind, lighting, and rim behavior are not part of this completeness pass.
The accepted raised-lawn carrier tint is evidence-constrained but not yet capture-qualified pixel-for-pixel.
The shared depth-shadow writer/matrix state remains outside this pass. Later evidence implements the shared native final-color stage and proves fog inactive in the captured Route 1 frame.
